article: Diagnose GitHub Copilot Certificate Errors Safely
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and twelve translations, error log, TLS/proxy diagnostic guidance, ESET security impact, command example, metadata, and current official GitHub/ESET documentation.
findings: Removed the unverified ESET blame and the instruction to leave global SSL/TLS inspection disabled.
Added safe network isolation, proxy diagnostics, trusted CA verification, and narrow app-specific ESET guidance.
Added GitHub’s certificate-validation warning and identified the 2024 license message as historical.
Removed the unrelated AWS CDK reference and duplicate future date; retained 2024-04-21 and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
